Thanks for helping keep these notes accurate. GitHub Copilot ships changes weekly and renames features often, so reports are always welcome.

Issues are public, so please leave out tokens, tenant IDs and customer details.

Do not post questions, answers or remembered topics from a live exam. Microsoft's exam security policy prohibits it:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/support/exam-and-assessment-lab-security-policies

For exam booking, score or retake problems, contact Microsoft Credentials support instead:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/support/help

## What Kind of Issue Is This?

<!-- Mark one with an x. -->

- [ ] **Content error:** text, a table, a callout, a diagram or a code sample is wrong
- [ ] **Outdated or renamed:** the product has changed since this was written
- [ ] **Exam coverage:** the notes don't match the official study guide
- [ ] **Site bug:** search, navigation, theme switcher, diagrams, layout, a broken link or accessibility
- [ ] **Suggestion:** something could be clearer or easier to study

## Where?

<!-- Paste a link to the page or section. Click the section in "On this page", then copy the address bar. -->

## What Is Wrong?

<!-- Quote what the notes say, or describe what happened. -->

## What Should It Be?

<!-- Give the correct information, or what you expected to happen. -->
